_README: Copy this file to config/bio.json and replace every value with your own.
config/bio.json is hard-blocked by .gitignore and must never be committed.
Any field you leave as null, "", or the literal string "ASK_ME" will cause
the applier agent to STOP and ask you before it types anything into a form.
Never invent an answer that is not in this file. That rule is absolute.

identity.headline: Computer Science student | Backend & distributed systems

location.relocation_notes: Open to relocation anywhere in the US for the internship term.

experience.title: Software Engineer Intern
experience.summary: Built an internal service that reduced manual triage time for the QA org.

work_authorization.visa_status_notes: One of: US_CITIZEN | PERMANENT_RESIDENT | F1_OPT | F1_CPT | H1B | TN | OTHER | ASK_ME

compensation.salary_answer_text: Open / negotiable based on the role and location.
compensation.notes: If a field is a free-text box, prefer salary_answer_text. If it demands a number, use the *_min value.

availability.graduation_constraint_notes: Available for the full 12-week summer term.

_README: Keys are matched loosely (case/punctuation-insensitive substring match) against
the ATS question label. Add your own keys freely — the agent reads this map first
and only escalates to you when no key matches.
US EEO / demographic questions. These are OPTIONAL by law.
The default for every field is PREFER_NOT_TO_SAY, and the agent must never
substitute a different value on your behalf. Change them only if you want to.
Runtime guardrails. The agent obeys this file over any prompt file.
autonomy_level sets how much the agent decides alone.
escalation.mode sets what happens when it cannot decide — and at
QUARANTINE_AND_CONTINUE the answer is never 'stop and ask the human'.
fact_integrity is the one thing that survives every level.

_autonomy_levels.SUPERVISED: Approve each application one at a time. Use on an ATS you have never watched it handle.
_autonomy_levels.BATCH_REVIEW: Agent fills the whole batch autonomously, then presents ONE review sheet you approve per-row. Safe default for a new clone.
_autonomy_levels.TRUSTED_BATCH: Like BATCH_REVIEW, but auto-approves rows where every field resolved cleanly. Only flagged rows reach you.
_autonomy_levels.AUTOPILOT: Submits clean rows unattended. Never blocks the run to ask a question. Anything undecidable is quarantined and waits for you in the audit sheet afterward.

_README: What the agent does when it hits something it cannot resolve.
QUARANTINE_AND_CONTINUE is the high-volume mode: set the job aside,
keep working the queue, hand over the pile at the end. The run never blocks.

_modes.BLOCK_AND_ASK: Stop, ask, wait. Lowest throughput, highest oversight.
_modes.QUARANTINE_AND_CONTINUE: Never interrupt. Park the job, continue, report at the end.

escalation._max_quarantined_note: A high quarantine rate means a systemic problem (bad config, ATS redesign). Abort rather than burn the queue.
hard_stop_only_for: request for SSN, government ID, or payment information
rate-limit or account warning from the platform
config/bio.json unreadable, or the resume file missing

_README: This survives every autonomy level and is what makes unattended
submission defensible: nothing is asserted to an employer that you
did not state. The agent may write prose; it may not invent facts.
fact_integrity._drafted_prose_note: Set false to route drafted cover letters and open-ended answers to the audit sheet instead of submitting them unattended.

post_run_audit._README: At AUTOPILOT this replaces the review gate. Written for every run, always.

autonomous_recovery._README: Fixed silently, without asking. All reversible — nothing here submits.

auto_approve_requires: all required fields resolved directly from bio.json
company and title matched the jobs.json record exactly

_README: These constrain what the AGENT does — not which sites are supported.
None of them name a platform, and none of them are a scope decision.
Nothing in ats_support can switch one of these on.
Which platforms this install applies through. A SCOPE setting, not a boundary.
tier_1 — public application forms, no sign-in. Works out of the box.
tier_2 — needs an authenticated session that YOU established in the browser
first. The agent never signs in; it works inside the session you
already have, exactly as it already does with your LinkedIn session.
Tier 2 is an open contribution area, not a prohibition. See docs/ROADMAP.md.
Add a platform here only once an adapter for it exists in prompts/.
_tier_2_note: If a tier-2 site is not already signed in, the row is QUARANTINED —
never a sign-in attempt, never an account creation. Sign in yourself
and re-run; the queue picks it up.

scope._README: Deliberate design choices. Revisitable by the project, unlike hard_boundaries.
_easy_apply_note: Excluded by design: this project exists to reach the employer's own ATS,
where applications are actually reviewed. Open an issue before building it.
